parameters.source: linked generator constructs an empty DetectorParams map; producer default is used

authoritative_semantics.formation_predicate: Maintain the latest three completed bars. Bullish formation requires middle close > middle open and last low > first high; bearish formation requires middle close < middle open and last high < first low. The gap must meet min_gap_atr against formation ATR and the middle body must be at least 0.20 ATR.
authoritative_semantics.formation_confirmation: The first bar supplies the origin edge, the middle bar is the impulse bar, and the third/latest completed bar supplies confirmation and the detection event.
authoritative_semantics.zone_identity: A monotonically increasing zone_id identifies each active zone in detector state.
authoritative_semantics.zone_bounds: Bullish bounds are lower=first high and upper=last low. Bearish bounds are lower=last high and upper=first low.
authoritative_semantics.first_touch: The first later bar whose range overlaps the zone emits fvg_first_touch.
authoritative_semantics.fill: A bullish zone fills when a later bar low reaches the lower edge; a bearish zone fills when a later bar high reaches the upper edge.
authoritative_semantics.persistence: Zones remain active until far-edge invalidation and are serialized/restored with the detector state envelope.
authoritative_semantics.leakage_boundary: Formation payload is emitted before later touch/fill processing; touch and fill are later-bar outcomes and cannot define formation-time cohorts.

lawful_availability.rule: For a normal completed bar i, available_time = received_ts_ns of the first source tick whose event_time_ns enters a later bucket; source_sequence is the equal-receipt causal tie-break. bar_close_ts(i)=CompletedBar.end_ts(i) remains the temporal boundary only.
lawful_availability.end_of_stream: No synthetic tail bar is emitted; a forming end-of-stream bar has no boundary-crossing receipt coordinate and is excluded from the sidecar.

supersedes_candidate.reason: candidate was restricted to the pre-recovery authority set; this freeze adds linked producer semantics and the completed-bar availability mapping
